vocabulary.term: Incident Roles Reduce Coordination Load
vocabulary.definition: Incident management works better when authority and communication responsibilities are explicit.

vocabulary.term: Graceful Degradation Under Overload
vocabulary.definition: When full service cannot be sustained under overload, intentionally degrading lower-priority work can preserve critical functionality.

vocabulary.term: Load Shedding
vocabulary.definition: Load shedding deliberately rejects or de-prioritizes excess work when accepting it would threaten the health of the system.

vocabulary.term: Overload Protection
vocabulary.definition: Overload protection aims to keep a service within a controllable operating region when incoming demand exceeds available capacity.

vocabulary.term: Queue Growth Under Overload
vocabulary.definition: When incoming work persistently exceeds service capacity, queues and latency grow unless the system limits, sheds, or reduces work.
